idea-plugin.name: Clean Terminal Copy
idea-plugin.description:
Copying text from the IDE terminal, e.g. replies of Claude Code or other CLI agents, brings along the layout of the terminal: a margin of spaces in front of every line and hard line breaks wherever the text wrapped at the terminal width.

This plugin cleans the clipboard right after you copy from the terminal (Ctrl+C or the context menu Copy). It
  • removes the margin shared by all lines, keeping relative indentation;
  • re-joins lines that were wrapped only because the terminal was too narrow, including wrapped list items;
  • drops trailing padding spaces and the agent's leading message bullet (●).
Nothing changes about Ctrl+C itself: with no selection it still interrupts.

Tested on Rider 2026.2 (Claude Code tab). Should work in any JetBrains IDE terminal.
